text.en:
The Bacolod Murcia-Pandanon-Don Salvador Benedicto-Calatrava Road in the Province of
Negros Occidental is converted into a national road.

The amount necessary for the improvement and maintenance of said road shall continue to be
funded out of the lump sum appropriation authorized under Batas Pambansa Blg. 640 for the repair and
maintenance of local roads until shall time that the maintenance funds for said road shall have been provided
for in the succeeding appropriations acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 7, 1984
